errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a peak in 2007 and a second peak in 2009. The chart shows a single peak for this period occurring in 2008 at a value of approximately 250 thousand sq. m. The description also incorrectly states the value for 2008 is 200 thousand sq. m.
The value for 2011 is approximately 80 thousand sq. m, not 90.
The value for 2019 is approximately 160 thousand sq. m, not 170.
The data point for 2021 is clearly below the 600 line on the y-axis, at a value of approximately 580 thousand sq. m.
Describing the initial trend as a decrease is misleading. While there is a dip from 2005 to 2006, the subsequent trend is a sharp increase to a peak in 2008. The initial phase is not just a decrease.

errors.evidence: The description lists an estimated value for every single data point across the 17-year period. This is excessively detailed and harms readability. A summary of the main trends would be more effective.
